welcome.taglineSame: Same place. Same game. Same night.
welcome.pitch: Spin a challenge, go do it with your crew, keep the proof.
welcome.error: That didn't work. Give it another go.
welcome.inviteHint: Got an invite link? Open it after you sign in and you'll land in the group.
welcome.forgotText: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
welcome.toLogin: Already have an account? Log in
welcome.confirmSent: We sent a link to {email}. Tap it to confirm your email and you're in.
welcome.resetSent: If there's an account for {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way.
welcome.linkError: That link didn't work here. If you just confirmed your email, log in below.
welcome.resetError: That reset link didn't work here. Ask for a fresh one below.

group.title: Who's breaking the loop with you?
group.yourName: What do your friends call you?
group.created: Crew created. Now drag your friends in.

join.title: You've been invited. Resistance is futile.

invite.shareText: Join {group} on Unloop. We're breaking the loop.

active.photoHint: Snap a photo while it's happening. It's worth +5 bonus points and it goes in the scrapbook.
active.later: Back to home (it'll wait for you)

proof.title: Pics or it didn't happen
proof.withPhoto: Add the photo and it's {n} each.

scrapbook.title: Scrapbook
scrapbook.count: {n, plural, =0 {no loops broken yet} one {# loop broken} other {# loops broken}}
scrapbook.empty: Empty pages. Go make some memories.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.nudge: {name}, one Extreme challenge and you're out of last place.

account.title: Account
account.newPasswordText: Pick one you'll remember. You'll use it to log in on any phone.

errors.needName: Give your crew a name first.
errors.badInvite: That invite link doesn't work. Ask for a fresh one.
errors.nothingFits: Nothing fits those filters. Loosen one up and spin again.
errors.nothingElse: That was the only one that fits. Looks like fate.
errors.nobody: Tick at least one person who showed up.
errors.upload: The photo didn't upload. Try again, or log it without one.
errors.notConfirmed: Confirm your email first. The link is in your inbox.
errors.userExists: There's already an account with that email. Log in instead.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.samePassword: That's your current password. Pick a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.emailFailed: We couldn't send the email. Try again later.
